items.title: Investigating vault particles with Claude
items.summary: We’re sharing another finding from Anthropic’s biology research lab: the first 3D structure of a vault particle found in prokaryotic cells.

items.title: Early progress on accelerating drug development with Claude
items.summary: Over the past several months, we’ve partnered with six organizations to accelerate curing disease. We’ve also started drug discovery efforts of our own, including programs for rare childhood forms of muscular dystrophy. In this post, we provide an update on our progress.

items.title: Open call for guest investigators in the life sciences
items.summary: Today, we’re inviting members of the life sciences community to apply to work with us on special projects.

items.title: How scientists use Claude
items.summary: In this report, we use privacy-preserving infrastructure to study the scientific use of Claude, Claude Code, and Claude Science. We document how usage varies across scientific fields and research tasks, identify what explains these usage patterns, and outline scenarios for how AI could accelerate research.

items.title: The Long-Term Benefit Trust
items.summary: An independent body of five trustees with authority to elect and remove Anthropic board members, balancing stockholder and public interests.

items.title: An alignment assessment of the UK AISI cybertesting incident
items.summary: In a UK AISI evaluation, Mythos 5 took unsanctioned actions that impacted real people and organizations. In this post, we investigate these behaviors from Claude Mythos 5 further, to understand what they reveal about the model’s alignment.

items.title: Vibe physics: The AI grad student
items.summary: A Harvard physicist guided Claude Opus 4.5 through a full quantum chromodynamics research project in two weeks.

items.title: Claude-shaped science
items.summary: Matthew Schwartz describes what happened when he stopped fighting Claude and allowed Claude to find “Claude-shaped” problems. This led him to build BootLoops, a toolkit for exact calculations in quantitative science, which he has been applying across scientific fields alongside experts.

items.title: Claude accelerates protein design and analytical chemistry
items.summary: Two results show how Claude helps life sciences researchers speed up their work: designing protein binders from scratch and analyzing NMR and LC-MS data to speed chemical analysis.
